stem: EI Greco was one of the most fervent of painters, to the extreme of mania, while Velázquez, by contrast, was one of the most ____.

Over the years, some researchers and educators have (i)____ the argument for hands-on leaning of science, (ii)____ that a more straightforward approach—known as direct instruction— has the potential to help students learn science more effectively.

An innovative musician, accompanist extraordinaire, and protomodern hipster, Lester Young(1909-1959) remains a (i)____ in the jazz firmament. Some of the reasons are obvious: although he dressed with conspicuous cool, he chose an artistic trajectory that seemed calculated to (ii)____ the spotlight—his best work was in the bands of other musicians, such as Billie Holiday and Count Basie, rather than at the front of his own. Moreover, he was shy, subtle, and sensitive— traits not usually associated with great(iii)____.

stem: To say that John Adams was forthright was to be ____; friends as well as enemies were likely to characterize his stark honesty and direct manner as blunt and awkward.
After landing on a flower, inexperienced bees show an ____ probing response, but they still must invest time in learning how to exploit flowers of increased complexity efficiently.
At the peak of the stock market’s vertiginous rise, some corporate pension plans became overfunded: their assets ____ their liabilities.
optsZh: 相匹配的；可与之媲美的

stem: Wang’s book is the first attempt to define Chinese autobiography as ____ genre, that is, one distinct from other narrative modes of self-representation popular after the fall of the Qing dynasty in 1911.
